Recite: *mantrapaṇe āhara āhara āyusandhāraṇi śodhaya śodhaya gaganaviśuddhe uṣṇīṣavijaye viśuddhe svāhā*.
Rāśmi-sañcodite sarvatathāgatavāk-karṇi-ṣṭhā-pra-mitā-paripūrani sarvatathāgatahrīdayāya.
ānīḍiṣṭa mahe mudrā-kāya saṃhatāna viṣṭape sarvavaraṇa-nibodha nṛtye pariviṣṭape.
*Pratiniṣṭhāpaya āyuṣmat tṛtīyaṃ māyādhiṣṭhitam ani mani mahāmani tattvabhūta-krodha-pariṣṭhe viṣapuṭa mṛtyu jahi.*
Jaya jaya vijaya vijaya samāra samāra sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhitadṛḍhavajrāvabhāsāvabhāsayasva.
Ā VADU MAMA [insert name] ŚARIRAN SARVA-SATTVA-DĀNAYA PARIVYŪDHATI SARVA-GATI-PARIVYŪDHATI SARVA-TATHĀGATA-ŚRĪM.
Oṃ gaccha maheśvara sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhita medya medya vimedya vimedya.
Vṛdhaya vṛdhaya vivardhaya vivardhaya samantaparivārttisa sarvatathāgatahr̥dayādhiṣṭhitādhiṣṭhitamahāmudre.
*Liḥ svāhā*. This dhāraṇī was originally brought to this land by the Tripitaka Master of Central India, Śubhakarasiṃha;
however, as it circulated among the various regions of the barbarian lands, all extant versions of the Buddha’s teachings were missing the mountain [passage].
Therefore, I have translated this complete version for circulation.
